title: Sorting Visualizer
description:
Animate sorting in the console with bars.
```
Bubble sort — step 14, swaps: 9, comparisons: 31
 7 | #######
 2 | ##
 9 | #########
 4 | ####
```
requirements: Implement bubble, selection, insertion, merge sort
Pass a "draw" callback (function pointer or `std::function`) that the sort calls after each step
Count comparisons and swaps; print a final comparison table
Time each on 5,000 random ints vs `std::sort`
